measurement_api.selection: SelectObject; original object restored in finally
measurement_api.cleanup: DeleteObject(font) in per-font finally; DeleteDC(memory_dc) in outer finally
measurement_api.missing_cmap_policy: Measure requested face for full union; absent cmap records flagged. GDI default/replacement widths are not proof of glyph coverage.

size_formula.W: MulDiv(s//2,96,7200); same integer truncation as reviewed eq8.py
size_formula.rounding: Positive Win32 MulDiv nearest integer, half up
size_formula.combinations: For each base 800/900/1100/1300 HU, iterative MulDiv(previous,68,100) depth 0..4, then each 100/50/120/180/200 percent; deduplicate H,W
